rtlDecisions.why: FaRoot direction:rtl makes the flex row read right-to-left: stem on the right, wheel on its left.
left:0 replaced with insetInlineStart:0 + width:100%, words start-aligned (right edge) hugging the stem.
Re-measured for the Persian word list (longest word about 107px) so the centred group is not empty/left-heavy; source prompt asks to re-measure width when words change.
Physical page-flip metaphor, not reading direction; no horizontal motion exists.

rtlDecisions.what: Vertical blur / opacity / colour ramps, STEPS, outQuint+outBack mix, fade-out
rtlDecisions.why: Pure motion design, must stay identical; beats and timing unchanged.
letterSpacing 0 (joining), fs(30)=33px, lineHeight = ROW so Persian ascenders/dots stay in the row.

concerns: Blur is the isotropic CSS blur (as in the original); hard clip at the mask edge is part of the original design.
lessons: Fixed-width mask windows sized for Latin words must be re-measured for Persian words, otherwise the centred group looks off-balance.
